You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Based on Figure 1, which of the following findings best supports the diagnosis of pleural synovial sarcoma in this patient?
A) Presence of a sharp-edged, lobulated mass in the left suprahilar region.
B) Bilateral pleural effusion with mediastinal widening.
C) Homogeneous opacity with calcifications in the left lower lobe.
D) Multiple nodules throughout both lung fields.
E) Large right-sided pleural effusion with mass effect.
F) Diffuse bilateral interstitial infiltrates.
